t: Magnusson inspection camera designed as a diagnostic tool for surveying inaccessible areas in trade and domestic settings. The bore scope features an 8mm waterproof camera head, equipped with 4 LED lights, enabling access into tight cavities such as pipework, ventilation ducts, or behind plasterboard. The 980mm detachable gooseneck probe provides exceptional reach, extending capabilities for plumbing, electrical, and HVAC professionals. The 2 1/3" high-resolution TFT colour screen offers clear, real-time viewing with a 360° image rotation function and adjustable brightness, ensuring comprehensive visual inspections.
b: 8mm Camera Head With 4 x LED Lights
